hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in */App/project.yml) cd "$(dirname "$f")" && xcodegen generate --spec project.yml >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo '{"systemMessage":"Projet Xcode régénéré (App/project.yml a changé)."}' ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath' | { read -r f; case "$f" in *.swift) swift format --in-place --configuration .swift-format "$f" ;; esac; } 2>/dev/null || true
